name: Polyethylene (gas phase, slurry, solution)
principle: Ethylene, with a comonomer such as butene or hexene for LLDPE and HDPE copolymers, is polymerised on a supported catalyst in a gas-phase fluidized-bed, slurry-loop or solution reactor. The resin leaves the reactor as powder or pellets after degassing to remove monomer, and is extruded with additives. The process route and catalyst (Ziegler-Natta, chromium or metallocene) set the grade range.

process_steps.name: Polymerisation reactor
equipment: gas-phase fluidized bed, slurry loop or solution reactor
